body:
I have previously rolled on Molly (MDMA) and Sass (got MDE instead of MDA). I will not go into either of those experiences, however, I will compare them to my latest rolling session.
A bit of background on my experiences with drugs: I smoke weed every day, I have taken mushrooms three times, I have taken Molly once and Sass once.
I smoke weed every day, I have taken mushrooms three times, I have taken Molly once and Sass once.
I am not on any medication. I have some intense drug anxiety, so before taking anything, Im always a bit tripped out. However, my drug anxiety always leaves after I ingest the substance.
I dosed on Christmas around 1:00PM. My girlfriend L was with me because I wanted her to see how it affected me before trying it herself. I was iffy on taking the Sass however, L was a bit pushy about it, so I took it. I figured that since my past experiences had been good, the drug anxiety I was experiencing would go away as soon as I took the pill. However, unlike my previous experiences, the come up was not comfortable at all. I felt moderate discomfort as I was coming up. I had been laying in bed with L watching her play GTA5, but I could not get comfortable. L tried to initiate sexual activities, but the discomfort I felt was too much to really get invested in it, so I told her I wasnt feeling it. I decided to play a game of League of Legends because I felt it would distract me until the Sass kicked in.
I was still feeling moderate discomfort, but as I played League, my vision would become blurry every so often. However, I was still able to concentrate on the game. I played League as much as I could before it became too much for me to handle. I tried to lay with L again, but I was too uncomfortable. I got up and looked in the human sized mirror on the back of my bedroom door and saw that my pupils were huge. I knew for a fact that I was close to reaching the end of the come up.
I decided I needed fresh air, and as soon as I walked outside, I felt a lot better. I went back inside and told L that I wanted to go for a walk. I live out in the country, so there is a canal about ⅔ of a mile away. I decided I wanted to walk there and back. I felt an energy in my feet that propelled them forward of their own accord. I figured that was the stimulant part of the drug. We got about ⅓ of the way to the canal before I got tired and wanted to go back.
When we got back to the house, it was about 2:00PM. By this point I was feeling pretty good. My moderate discomfort turned into minor discomfort, and I was starting to feel the warm happiness I associate with Sass. I went back in my room with L and at that point we tried to have sex again. This time I was more aroused. I tried fucking L and I just got lost in it before realizing that I wasnt even hard anymore, and my sex drive just wasnt there. I apologized to her and she was fine with it.
I heard my dad taking a shower in the bathroom, so I hollered at my mom to tell me when he was done so I could also shower. I knew that my bodys temperature signals were fucked up, but I didnt realize the full extent until I showered. I adjusted the waters temperature to what I knew would be comfortable for me, but the hot water felt cold against my skin, and it even gave me goosebumps. The cold feeling was discomforting, but I found that somehow I didnt mind it. After turning off the water, I found that I was so cold that I was shaking. After drying off and rejoining L, I recounted this experience to her.
At this point, it was time to leave to see Star Wars: The Force Awakens. I got in the car with L, my dad, my mom, and sister. The car ride was somewhat unpleasant, but I found that closing my eyes and listening to music relieved the minor discomfort. I brought a water bottle with me so that I could sip on it and because I had been getting urges to drink water. However, I knew that the Sass was doing that to me and small sips of water quenched my bodys false need for water. I also knew my inhibitions would be lowered, and Sass being Sass, I would have the urge to just talk and talk and talk. I refrained from doing this in order to stay hidden among those who didnt know I was rolling like a motherfucker. On my previous journey with Sass, I had been in public while rolling, so I knew I could handle it. My eyes were also dilated as fuck, so I wore sunglasses up until entering the movie theater.
At this point it was 3:30PM, and the movie started at 3:50PM. I talked to L a bunch during the previews and as the movie started, I hit my zen point where I felt nothing but warm goodness. This leads me to the disappointing part of the experience. My previous experience with Sass
had come in 6 waves with each wave lasting about an hour and each wave was exponentially better than the last. This Sass didnt do that. It plateaued at the first wave and stayed that way. While somewhat disappointing, I didnt really care.
After the movie it was about 6:45PM and it was dark outside. I was able to use the bathroom normally (for some reason, I felt like my bodily functions were outta whack) and went outside the cinema and drove home with my parents and L. When we got home at 7:10PM, L and I went in my room and got comfortable in pjs and lied down. I was still feeling the same plateau feeling I felt at the start of Star Wars.
At this point L and I began conversating. I was feeling very introspective and this allowed L and I to talk about our relationship. We talked until 8:30PM when she went to sleep while cuddling me. Im mentioning this because as I layed there, I felt very trapped because I was still rolling and it tripped me the fuck out that there was a girl laying on me and I couldnt move if I didnt want to wake her up. That was trippy as fuck.
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
At 9:00PM I drove L home. The whole roll had been very clear headed, and the come down left me in an even clearer state of mind. Ive also driven on Sass before on the coast so I knew I could handle it. I wasnt rolling terribly hard either, and I knew the comedown was happening because I was into my 8th hour of rolling.
I knew the comedown was happening because I was into my 8th hour of rolling.
Unlike my previous Sass experience, this Sass was less fire, but it lasted longer.
When I got home, it was 9:30PM. I knew I was coming down and since this roll was not similar to my previous Sass experience, I thought the comedown would leave me depressed. While it hasnt ever happened to me, many people have told me that Molly and Sass have bad comedowns, so I didnt want to take any chances. My remedy for this was to take a fat ass snap of keef. I have been smoking on this fire 5 g nug and there was a mountain of keef in my grinder that I could not resist.
When I went inside after smoking, around 9:50PM, I was feeling blown away. Unlike Molly, in my experience, Sass does not give me the ability to smoke unlimited weed. On Molly I feel like the high from the Cannabis is just sitting on top of my roll. In other words, I can feel the weeds presence, but I cant feel its effects. Smoking while rolling however seems to intensify the effects. I wasnt just high, I had magnified the comedown to a point where I wasnt rolling, and I wasnt high, but a strange combination of the two. I felt stoned but also warm like when I had been rolling. I played GTA 5 for a bit before deciding I wanted to sleep.
It was 12:00AM when I went to sleep. I wouldnt really call it sleep though. Basically I closed my eyes and fell into a GTA 5 fever dream, except without the unpleasantness. I was also still feeling my fluctuating temperature, except it had changed into feeling extremes of one temperature that made sense. For example, under the covers, my feet were extremely hot, but outside of the covers, they were very cold. I didnt find a remedy for this, but I guess I passed out for a bit because after 10 minutes of closing my eyes and going into the fever dream, I opened my eyes again and it was 2:00AM. I closed them again for about what I thought was 10 minutes and it was 8AM. Then, finally, I actually slept until 11AM on December 26th.
It was 12:00PM before I really got up. I texted L and asked her what she thought about what she saw. She said she really liked how I was on Sass and said that my happy mood made her happy as well, and that she was excited to try it. I was feeling slightly fried, but not too bad. I was a bit sluggish, but I was able to eat. Around 1:30PM, my homie, M, hit me up and I dipped off to his house. We smoked some pretty alright weed and then smoked a blunt with the same weed, but blunts are my favorite way to smoke, so I got a placebo of feeling even higher. Around 4:00PM we dipped off to our other friends house and chilled with him for a bit. I didnt smoke any more weed, because I had work at 5:30PM.
Ill spare you the details of my job, but by the end of my shift, it was 11:45PM. I took my coworker home and I got home at 12:45AM fried as fuck, I smoked some weed and it made the fried feeling go away. Now it is 1:30AM as I write this, and this will be where I conclude my experience.
It was an 8/10 experience that I would do again.
PROS I experienced:
Improved mood
Warm feeling all over my body
Plateau feeling (While I indicated this was disappointing, in retrospect, I liked the mild feeling, and it was good for L to see what was up with Sass)
Introspective thinking
Bonding with L
Treats my depression
Comedown intensified by Cannabis
Clear headedness
About as low key as weed (Minus pupil dilation)
The mindset I entered the roll with was the same after the roll
Lasted a long time
CONS I experienced:
Discomforting come up
Temperature fluctuation
Reduced sex drive
Sleeping issues
Fried as fuck afterward (Cannabis relieved this for me)
